sources.says: Going all in on founders who go all in. Leads pre-seed and seed rounds. Cheque USD 250K to 600K.
Focus consumer tech, deeptech, fintech, consumer brands, while staying sector-agnostic.

criteria.name: Founder quality
criteria.good: Founders who go all in: full-time, years of hands-on work in the exact problem, evidence they can sell and build. Score evidence, not pedigree.

criteria.name: Path to market
criteria.good: A named first buyer, a channel that already works at small scale, acquisition cost and payback stated with how they were measured.

criteria.name: Evidence quality
criteria.good: Traction numbers that are specific, dated, consistent between deck and form, and checkable; repeat use, not just sign-ups.

criteria.name: Defensibility
criteria.good: Something that gets harder to copy with time: data, distribution, regulation handled, or a workflow customers depend on.

criteria.name: Sector fit
criteria.good: Inside fintech, deeptech, consumer tech or consumer brands, judged by what the company does, not the label it picked.

criteria.name: Capital fit
criteria.good: Pre-seed or seed round the fund can lead with a USD 250K to 600K cheque; sensible valuation and a use of funds tied to milestones.

gates.max_round_why: The fund leads with up to about INR 5 Cr (USD 600K); a round over three times that cannot be led by it. Proposal until Kushal approves.
